newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Eletrobras stake in Light to be sold.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Eletrobras stake in Light to be sold.

text.p: Brazilian state power firm Eletrobras' remaining 24 percent stake in privatized electricity distributor Light is to be sold in mid-1997, said the vice-president of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES).

Jose Pio Borges said Brazil's National Privatization Council (CND) had approved contracting financial advisors to coordinate the international public offer of Eletrobras remaining stake worth $1 billion in Light's voting share capital.
"Light is very optimistic about next year's financial results, which makes the public offer possible," Borges said.
The 24 percent stake is to be sold off in the second half of next year.
Light was privatized May 21, with 34.04 percent of the company's total capital being sold off to private investors.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
